summary: Implemented the SHACL path parsing feature. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the prepared venv. Not committed. Unverified: mypy and black are not installed in the venv, so type-checking and formatting were not run. The one unreachable-guard line in shacl.py carries a type: ignore[unreachable] that may need removing if mypy flags it as unused.
